reviews.classification: partial actual crosswalk review; retain supplier scope and current authority; remainder open
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual review currently covers original lines1–140 only: opening provenance/state terms, summary, MIE-G1–G14, PROGRESSION_WORLD_STATE:G1–G14, MAW-X1–X9, PT86–PT112 (listed subset includingPT99), and AY6–AY12. Original lines141–1169 remain for substantive review; this is not a whole-inventory verdict. The inventory's source coverage/outline/chat counts describe its October25 extraction and routing, not fresh reads of all suppliers or runtime proof. All ideas stay on the table, and the existing November4 current-routing note prevents dated status and reserved-worker labels from becoming the live build order.

F2: Keep graded admission, native catalogue use, symbolic formula fit, quality/potency/risk/residue, retained provenance, units and directional compatibility as distinct MIE mechanisms. A proposal label does not prove source absence, as the same MIE-G1/G10 text already notes partial implementation. Later material/substitution delivery reviewed in B527 establishes an attributed selected typed-unit/native cooking and directional ORIGINAL HP consumer beyond this snapshot; it does not deliver arbitrary chemistry, every quality reader or universal exchange. The earlier generic pack-save unwired row is also superseded at named registered registry/save seams in the later progress-evidence reconciliation. No new current source check is performed here. Preserve gate descriptor versus actual overflow reader, path shape versus crossing UI, body/attention terms, three kinds of revision pin and frozen pending-command compatibility as separate selected questions.

F3: MAW tooling and integration rows retain their own conditional benefit and ownership. An export-name register scan cannot prove semantic coverage; two harnesses sharing setup does not prove their native outcomes. AD51 qualifies old two-caller/second-world prerequisite language, AD41 replaces automatic worktree creation, AD36 scopes checks, and existing save direction qualifies universal old-fixture requirements. Historical model/effort labels, machine cores, origins, checkout/staging/commit recipes and live D-lane claims grant no current workers, spend, integration or push. The crosswalk's copied extraction fields, such as AY11/AY12 effort/done text, preserve source provenance rather than becoming new runtime commands.

F4: PT86–PT112 retain useful distinctions among natural pace, tickrate, sliced fast-forward, deterministic stepping and Node; model answer format/cache effects are dated measurements, not a current speed promise. Reasoning can change a choice and model disagreement is a heuristic rather than calibrated confidence. Stakes and allowed action remain derived from observer-safe game projections. A seeded route comparison needs matching policy/time/remainder, not a blanket claim all legitimate clocks must equal. Shorter settles await actual authority/publication, and a deferred slow second look is offline analysis rather than permission to replay paid state. Wall-budget exhaustion cannot silently waive required checks. AY6–AY12 preserve station route reuse, inspection versus attack target, shared Back/Escape and departed-person feedback; old proposal/unverified labels require the actual current owner before implementation. These are content dispositions, not source repairs or new universal gates.
reviews.evidence: Actual original1–100 read with dense-output truncation recovered at60–82, then101–140 read in full. Original body1169 lines at input; remaining141–1169 not credited. Supporting current dispositions already saved in B527/B532/B533 and task report; no underlying runtime/source/body evidence revalidation.
reviews.reopen: Continue original lines141–1169 in bounded dense-table chunks, then review appended owner notes and cumulative coverage before full-file credit.
